sn22.94:1.5: The Buddha rejects the metaphysical views of absolute, eternal existence and annihilation ([sn12.15:3.1](), [sn12.48:2.2]()), but he asserts the reality of that which is conditioned and impermanent, namely the aggregates.
sn22.94:4.1: The Pali is _loke lokadhammo_, and it seems necessary to keep the overly-literal rendering “worldly phenomenon in the world” to maintain the pattern of the discourse, which alludes to the explanatory idea that it is the world because it “wears away” ([sn35.82:2.3]()).
